capabilities: Install and launch the DSH service in the background
Embed the DSH web UI in an iframe panel
Bridge note selections into DSH chat and open DSH artifacts in Obsidian
Update DSH, repair sessions, and rescue a broken install via dsh-fix
Set up HTTPS certificates and LAN access from phones
disambiguation: Not an AI chatbot itself; it installs, launches and embeds the separate DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agent framework rather than implementing one.
extras: Desktop-only (Windows/macOS), Obsidian 1.7.2+; bilingual English/Chinese README; the plugin is listed as not yet reviewed by Obsidian staff; README warns that binding a non-loopback address exposes DSH to the LAN and that network access to model providers depends on the configured task.
problem: Running the DSH agent against vault notes normally requires command-line setup and service management, with no connection between the agent and the editor.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian desktop plugin that embeds the native DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI into your vault

requires.name: Model API key (default DeepSeek API; OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible or local model)

summary: Desktop plugin that installs and runs the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) AI agent service, embeds its web UI in Obsidian, and bridges note selections to its chat.
